{{Top|leg}}
'''Tarisian kelp''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Kelp/Legends|kelp]] that was native to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. It was regularly harvested to provide the inhabitants of Taris with food. The kelp forests were eventually almost entirely destroyed by increasing levels of toxic industrial pollution; this caused a planet-wide famine that led to the [[Tarisian Civil War]] and general decay of that planet. The remaining kelp, along with the remaining oceanic fauna, was later consumed to extinction by the Tarisian nobles.
